mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.* FROM com_contract c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_project_contract_relation r WHERE r.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND r.contract_id = c.id AND r.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (r.effective_from IS NULL OR r.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_delivery_scope s JOIN com_sales_order_line l ON l.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND l.id = s.order_line_id AND l.deleted = 0 JOIN com_sales_order o ON o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND o.id = l.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE s.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND s.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.scope_status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.effective_to IS NULL AND o.contract_no IS NOT NULL AND CAST(o.contract_no AS BINARY) = CAST(c.contract_no AS BINARY) AND CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY) = CAST(c.company_code AS BINARY)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_delivery_scope s2 JOIN com_sales_order_line l2 ON l2.tenant_id = s2.tenant_id AND l2.id = s2.order_line_id AND l2.deleted = 0 JOIN com_sales_order o2 ON o2.tenant_id = l2.tenant_id AND o2.id = l2.order_id AND o2.deleted = 0 JOIN com_order_contract_relation oc ON oc.tenant_id = o2.tenant_id AND oc.order_id = o2.id AND oc.contract_id = c.id AND oc.deleted = 0 AND oc.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (oc.effective_to IS NULL OR oc.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE s2.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND s2.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND s2.deleted = 0 AND s2.scope_status = 'ACTIVE' AND s2.effective_to IS NULL) ) ORDER BY c.contract_no, c.id

SELECT DISTINCT o.* FROM com_sales_order o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_project_contract_relation r JOIN com_contract c ON c.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND c.id = r.contract_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (r.effective_from IS NULL OR r.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND o.contract_no IS NOT NULL AND CAST(o.contract_no AS BINARY) = CAST(c.contract_no AS BINARY) AND CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY) = CAST(c.company_code AS BINARY)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_project_contract_relation r2 JOIN com_order_contract_relation oc ON oc.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id AND oc.contract_id = r2.contract_id AND oc.deleted = 0 AND oc.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (oc.effective_to IS NULL OR oc.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE r2.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r2.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND r2.deleted = 0 AND r2.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (r2.effective_from IS NULL OR r2.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (r2.effective_to IS NULL OR r2.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND oc.order_id = o.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_delivery_scope s3 JOIN com_sales_order_line l3 ON l3.tenant_id = s3.tenant_id AND l3.id = s3.order_line_id AND l3.deleted = 0 WHERE s3.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND s3.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND s3.deleted = 0 AND s3.scope_status = 'ACTIVE' AND s3.effective_to IS NULL AND l3.order_id = o.id) ) ORDER BY o.order_create_time, o.id
SELECT * FROM com_crm_execution_order WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND primary_project_id = #{query.projectId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY execution_no, id
